- Official name: 2026 Formula 1 Gulf Air Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia
- Venue: Sepang International Circuit, Malaysia
- Dates: October 2-4, 2026 (Round 16 of 23)
- Last F1 race at Sepang: 2017 (9-year gap)
- Circuit: 5.543 km, 15 corners, 56 laps
- Race start: 15:00 local time / 08:00 BST / 03:00 ET Sunday

- Alpine: reviewing "course of action" regarding Colapinto's seat following the incident
- Colapinto age: 21 (Argentine, from Buenos Aires)
- Colapinto joined Alpine for 2026 after Williams exit
- 2027 grid: Colapinto confirmed at Alpine alongside Pierre Gasly (contracted to 2028)
**Freshness:** Penalty confirmed for this weekend. HIGH freshness.
**Why it matters:** Colapinto's Malaysia result directly affects his Alpine future.
